privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Khan Travel Services e.K. handles the personal data you share with us when you apply to become a B2B partner.

who.title: 1. Who is responsible
who.intro: The controller responsible for processing your personal data on this website is:

data.title: 2. What data we collect
data.form_intro: When you apply to become a partner, we collect the information you enter:
form_items: Company name, including its legal form
First and last name of the contact person
Business email address and phone number
Whether you have already been in contact with one of our employees
Your confirmation that you may represent the company, and your consent to this policy
Date and time of your application
data.tech_text: To keep the form secure and protect it against spam and abuse, we process your IP address for a short time. It is used to limit repeated submission attempts and may appear in our security logs. When you visit the page, our web server also records standard access data (such as time of access and browser type) in its log files.

purpose.title: 3. Why we use your data

items.strong: To review your application and contact you
items.text: about a possible partnership. This is necessary to take steps at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

items.strong: To send you a confirmation email
items.text: and to notify our team about your application (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
and prevent spam, fraud and abuse. This is our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
which you give with the checkbox in the form (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future.

purpose.outro: If your application is approved, your details are used to set up your partner account on our B2B booking platform. We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising without your permission.

recipients.title: 4. Who receives your data
recipients.intro: Your application is only seen by the Khan Travel Services e.K. team responsible for partner applications. We also work with carefully selected service providers who process data on our behalf:

items.text: our web hosting provider stores the website and the application database.

confirmation and notification emails are sent through Resend (Resend, Inc., USA). Where data is transferred outside the EU/EEA, this is based on appropriate safeguards such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
if activated, the form uses Friendly Captcha (Friendly Captcha GmbH, Germany) to check that submissions come from real people. It works without cookies and without tracking.

recipients.outro: We only pass on data to authorities if we are legally required to do so.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies and tracking
paragraphs: This page uses two technically necessary cookies: a session cookie that protects the form against misuse (for example, cross-site request forgery) and is deleted when you close your browser, and a language cookie that remembers your selected language for one year. We do not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.
Fonts and scripts are loaded from our own server, so no data is sent to font providers such as Google Fonts.

retention.title: 6. How long we keep your data
paragraphs: If your application is approved, we keep your data for as long as the partnership exists, and afterwards as long as legal retention periods (for example under commercial and tax law) require.

If your application does not lead to a partnership, we delete your data as soon as it is no longer needed, at the latest 12 months after our decision, unless you have agreed to a longer storage period. Security data such as IP-based rate-limit entries are deleted automatically after a short time.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.intro: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
items: access the personal data we hold about you (Art. 15)
have your data deleted (Art. 17) or its processing restricted (Art. 18)
receive your data in a portable format (Art. 20)
object to processing based on our legitimate interests (Art. 21)
withdraw your consent at any time (Art. 7(3))
rights.outro: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, in particular in the EU member state where you live or work.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.text: If you have questions about this policy or want to use your rights, please contact us at :email. We will answer as quickly as possible.
contact.update: We may update this policy when our services or legal requirements change. The current version is always available on this page.

protection.title: Data protection
paragraphs: Protecting your personal data is particularly important to us. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with legal data protection regulations and this privacy policy.
With this statement, we inform you about the nature, scope and purpose of the collection and use of personal data on our website.
